pool_rule: Benchmark strings: every adjusted_ingredients string from the listed benchmark JSON files, cleaned with clean_string() (normalize_thai(strip()) with zero-width characters U+200B/U+200C/U+200D/U+FEFF removed) and deduplicated; strings matched by is_garbled() are excluded; if BENCHMARK_SAMPLE is set, a random.Random(42) sample of that many of the sorted surviving strings. Then every MOCK_RECIPES ingredient string in database/seed_postgres.py that is not already in the pool. Then INMU rows with a non-empty Thai_Name from nutrition/data/inmu_nutrition_dataset.csv, sampled with random.Random(42) from the CSV rows in file order (INMU_N rows), deduplicated against everything already in the pool, so INMU may yield fewer than INMU_N items. Source attribution priority is benchmark > base_recipe > inmu. Stored strings are in normalize_thai form.
edge_semantics: A → B means a typical preparation of A contains B

key_definitions.shrimp: IN: shrimp/prawn, shrimp paste, dried shrimp, shrimp-based sauces. OUT: other crustaceans and molluscs (those are 'shellfish').
key_definitions.shellfish: IN: crab, lobster/crayfish, and all molluscs including bivalves (clam, oyster, mussel, cockle) and cephalopods (squid, octopus, cuttlefish). OUT: shrimp/prawn (own key), finned fish.
key_definitions.fish: IN: finned fish and fish-derived products (fish sauce, pla-ra, dried/fermented fish, fish balls). OUT: squid/molluscs/crustaceans (even though the Thai word for squid contains the fish word).
key_definitions.egg: IN: bird eggs (chicken, duck, quail) and products containing them (mayonnaise, custard, egg noodles when egg is a stated ingredient). OUT: insect eggs (e.g. ant eggs), fish roe, reptile eggs.
key_definitions.milk: IN: animal milk and dairy (milk, cream, butter, cheese, yogurt, milk powder, condensed milk). OUT: plant milks (soy milk, coconut milk/cream), and words that merely contain the milk syllable (e.g. Thai words for sweets/snacks).
key_definitions.gluten: IN: wheat, barley, rye and derivatives (wheat flour, wheat noodles, bread/crackers, soy sauce and oyster sauce made with wheat). OUT: rice, tapioca, mung-bean flour, corn, and oats on their own.
key_definitions.soy: IN: soybeans and derivatives (tofu, soy milk, soy sauce, fermented soybean paste, edamame, soy flour). OUT: refined soybean oil.
key_definitions.peanut: IN: peanuts and products containing them (satay sauce, peanut butter, peanut oil unrefined). OUT: tree nuts.
key_definitions.nut: IN: tree nuts (almond, cashew, walnut, hazelnut, pistachio, pecan, chestnut). OUT: peanut, coconut, nutmeg, water chestnut.
